extensions.source_gap: Dispatcher receives Admission+Frame but lacks exact incoming generation
extensions.extension: Add session-aware dispatcher accepting exact SessionHandle and immutable admitted value. Preserve old dispatcher for existing consumers; configuration rejects simultaneous ambiguous dispatchers. Chat returns no direct response frames after its room publication.
extensions.compatibility: Existing heartbeat/direction/boot/single writer unchanged; legacy dispatcher tests retained
extensions.effect: No canonical write/lock; no raw Conn; reject stale handle rather than resolve a newer handle by lookup

extensions.source_gap: Handle metadata lacks exact admitted Guild JOIN identity
extensions.extension: Add immutable admitted binding value and typed accessor/authorized registration seam; production registration supplies exact app Admission from Auth.Authorize. Legacy Replace remains compatible; a Guild handle without retained binding is ineligible for chat.
extensions.compatibility: Do not substitute membership_version or current GuildID; preserve newest context+role and multi-context indexes
extensions.effect: In-memory metadata only, never copied Guild authority

extensions.owner: I4 liveness/directory + I5 PlayerType + I6C binding via typed postgres composition
extensions.source_gap: Pool-backed read calls alone do not guarantee one coherent authorization/presentation snapshot
extensions.extension: Narrow callerTx reader composes existing RealtimeAuthority{Queryer:t}, guildprojection.RealtimeMembership{Queryer:t}, playerpresentation.Service with existing I4/I5 readers bound to t; no duplicated foreign-owner SQL.
extensions.compatibility: Existing playerpresentation.TxReader includes Presence and remains unchanged; plain chat does not need Presence

effect.commit: One caller-owned tx commits once; semantic output private until DefiniteCommit. Any unknown/error aborts preparation/publication; no replay.

retry.reason: Fresh bounded authorization observation, no settlement or receipts. No retry around socket work.

effect.time: One fresh PostgreSQL clock_timestamp observation per bounded sender/recipient read. No NamedEpoch/quota policy is added; process monotonic clocks govern transport deadlines only.

acceptance: 5A matrix rows on exact future candidate before acceptance; source/static/component/probe/native/physical classes separate
